reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: I absolutely love Collect! It has made filing my claims so much easier and faster—I can get everything submitted in less than 3 minutes! I also love that I’m always kept updated when new eligible applications become available. It’s so convenient and takes the stress out of keeping up with everything. I’m honestly so happy I found Collect! Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Uhm no
reviews.text: Asks you a bunch of questions then tries making you pay  over a hundred for a yearly and/$13 a month. Doesn’t let you see if it works first no test try or trial length nothing just answer questions claim how much you’ve missed and forces payment. Don’t believe false reviews if they claim to love an app but not once mention having to pay to even use it. It’s a way to get downloads and claimed as free hit not even in the slightest it’s free download not use

reviews.title: Legit a scam
reviews.text: 1st red flag - when you get the app it’ll give you a short survey to “estimate” how much money you’ve already lost by not filling past settlements ,clicking no on every single one of the questions should mean you haven’t lost anything right? No because apparently you have lost $1019 for literally no reason also the amount of money you’ve lost changes every time the 2nd time (clicking the same answers) I apparently lost $1081
